row.notes: Whole body read. Finds k_Game_PlayerCustomisationInfoSystemDesc and k_Live_EntrantsSystemKey in the map at g_Game_Manager+0x30, takes the key at info+0x1b8 (default 0x3fff0000) and calls Ent_Get_Badge_Thunk(entrants, &key). Writes 12 bytes to out12: badge +0xc0..+0xcb if found, else element 1 (+0xc..+0x17) of the 12-byte vector at g_FeTile_CustomisationSystem+0x1d8 when it has at least 2 elements, else all 0xff. Returns out12. Caller 0x141687cd0: holder constructor, clears the list node at +0x140 and appends the three 4-byte parts as indexed children (0x1416bed40). Caller 0x1417ed270 (case 0) and Ui_ShopItem_Bind call it the same way before Vm_Node_Clear on their list nodes. The 12 bytes are three uint32 values, likely the badge colour triple (not proven).
